**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Make frozen crop locations relocatable**

When the freeze is replayed under a different account or run root, this absolute path changes the manifest hash; the committed manifest consequently contains `/home/samsen/...` paths that fail `validate_inputs` on other machines before a run can start. This also makes the published manifest SHA impossible to reproduce outside the original home directory even though the crop bytes are deterministic. Store a path relative to a declared frozen-input root and resolve it at validation time.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Retry semantically invalid full-pass responses**

When the provider returns valid JSON whose field values cannot be normalized, `call_with_retries` treats the first response as successful and returns before `evaluate` performs semantic validation, so none of the configured retries are used. This occurred for `9709_w24_qp_11_q04`: it had one full attempt, failed on an invalid subpart label, and was nevertheless classified as `full_pass_failed_after_retries`, reducing the completed-result count without attempting recovery. Include candidate normalization in the retry success condition, or avoid claiming retries were exhausted.

+        "p90": percentile(values, 0.90),
+        "p95": percentile(values, 0.95),
+        "max": round(max(values), 3) if values else None,
+        "mean": round(sum(values) / len(values), 3) if values else None,
+        "total": round(sum(values), 3),
+    }
+
+
+def ratio_metric(passed: int, total: int) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    return {"pass": passed, "total": total, "percent": f"{passed * 100 / total:.6f}%"}
+
+
+def finalize(rows: list[dict[str, Any]], manifest: dict[str, Any], truth: dict[str, dict[str, Any]]) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any]]:
+    expected_ids = [row["question_id"] for row in manifest["questions"]]
+    indexed = index_rows(rows, "question_id", "terminal")
+    if set(indexed) != set(expected_ids):
+        raise RuntimeError("terminal_membership_mismatch_global_stop")
+    ordered = [indexed[key] for key in expected_ids]
+    count = len(ordered)
+    full_attempts = [attempt for row in ordered for attempt in row["full_pass"]["attempts"]]
+    mark_attempts = [attempt for row in ordered for attempt in row["mark_pass"]["attempts"]]
+    full_latency = [float(row["latency_seconds"]) for row in full_attempts if row.get("latency_seconds") is not None]
+    mark_latency = [float(row["latency_seconds"]) for row in mark_attempts if row.get("latency_seconds") is not None]
+    combined_question_latency = [
+        sum(float(attempt["latency_seconds"]) for attempt in row["full_pass"]["attempts"] if attempt.get("latency_seconds") is not None)
+        + sum(float(attempt["latency_seconds"]) for attempt in row["mark_pass"]["attempts"] if attempt.get("latency_seconds") is not None)
+        for row in ordered
+    ]
+    first_metrics = {field: ratio_metric(sum(row["first_pass_checks"][field] for row in ordered), count) for field in FIELDS}
+    final_metrics = {field: ratio_metric(sum(row["checks"][field] for row in ordered), count) for field in FIELDS}
+    fallback_ids = [row["question_id"] for row in ordered if row["mark_pass_disposition"] != "merged"]
+    mismatch_ids = [row["question_id"] for row in ordered if any(str(w).startswith("mark_pass_count_mismatch:") for w in row["warnings"])]
+    false_override_ids = [
+        row["question_id"] for row in ordered
+        if row["mark_pass_disposition"] == "merged"
+        and row["first_pass_checks"]["visible_marks"]
+        and not row["checks"]["visible_marks"]
+    ]
+    override_ids = [
+        row["question_id"] for row in ordered
+        if row["mark_pass_disposition"] == "merged" and row["first_pass_normalized"] != row["normalized"]
+    ]
+    summary = {
+        "schema_version": "9709_unseen_local_two_pass_validation_summary_v1",
+        "issue": ISSUE,
+        "runner_git_sha": MERGED_RUNNER_GIT_SHA,
+        "runner_file_sha256": MERGED_RUNNER_FILE_SHA256,
+        "paper_count": 8,
+        "question_count": count,
+        "silent_missing_count": 0,
+        "terminal_status_counts": dict(sorted(Counter(row["terminal_status"] for row in ordered).items())),
+        "first_pass_field_checks": first_metrics,
+        "final_field_checks": final_metrics,
+        "first_pass_end_to_end": ratio_metric(sum(row["first_pass_all_field_checks_pass"] for row in ordered), count),
+        "final_end_to_end": ratio_metric(sum(row["all_field_checks_pass"] for row in ordered), count),
+        "strict_full_schema": ratio_metric(sum(row["strict_full_schema"] for row in ordered), count),
+        "mark_pass_merged_count": sum(row["mark_pass_disposition"] == "merged" for row in ordered),
+        "mark_pass_override_count": len(override_ids),
+        "mark_pass_override_question_ids": override_ids,
+        "false_override_count": len(false_override_ids),
+        "false_override_question_ids": false_override_ids,
+        "mark_count_mismatch_count": len(mismatch_ids),
+        "mark_count_mismatch_question_ids": mismatch_ids,
+        "mark_fallback_count": len(fallback_ids),
+        "mark_fallback_question_ids": fallback_ids,
+        "warning_question_ids": [row["question_id"] for row in ordered if row["warnings"]],
+        "residual_question_ids": [row["question_id"] for row in ordered if not row["all_field_checks_pass"]],
+        "provider": {
+            "full_attempt_count": len(full_attempts),
+            "mark_attempt_count": len(mark_attempts),
+            "full_retry_count": max(0, len(full_attempts) - count),
+            "mark_retry_count": max(0, len(mark_attempts) - count),
+            "full_failed_request_count": sum(not attempt.get("parseable") for attempt in full_attempts),
+            "mark_failed_request_count": sum(not attempt.get("parseable") for attempt in mark_attempts),
+            "terminal_full_failure_count": sum(row["terminal_status"] == "full_pass_failed_after_retries" for row in ordered),
+        },
+        "latency_seconds": {
+            "full_attempts": latency_distribution(full_latency),
+            "mark_attempts": latency_distribution(mark_latency),
+            "all_attempts": latency_distribution(full_latency + mark_latency),
+            "combined_per_question": latency_distribution(combined_question_latency),
+        },
+        "candidate_only_not_canonical_truth": True,
+        "paid_external_call_count": 0,
+        "remote_or_canonical_write_count": 0,
+    }
+    candidates = {
+        "schema_version": "9709_unseen_local_two_pass_candidate_results_v1",
+        "issue": ISSUE,
+        "candidate_only_not_canonical_truth": True,
+        "rows": [{key: row.get(key) for key in (
+            "question_id", "paper_id", "question_number", "page_chain", "source_crop_sha256",
+            "terminal_status", "strict_full_schema", "first_pass_normalized", "normalized",
+            "mark_pass_disposition", "warnings", "first_pass_checks", "checks",
+            "first_pass_all_field_checks_pass", "all_field_checks_pass", "image_inventory",
+        )} for row in ordered],
+    }
+    residual_rows = []
+    for row in ordered:
+        if row["all_field_checks_pass"] and not row["warnings"]:
+            continue
+        residual_rows.append({
+            "question_id": row["question_id"],
+            "paper_id": row["paper_id"],
+            "page_chain": row["page_chain"],
+            "terminal_status": row["terminal_status"],
+            "expected": truth[row["question_id"]]["expected"],
+            "first_pass": row["first_pass_normalized"],
+            "final": row["normalized"],
+            "first_pass_checks": row["first_pass_checks"],
+            "final_checks": row["checks"],
+            "mark_pass_disposition": row["mark_pass_disposition"],
+            "warnings": row["warnings"],
+            "full_attempt_count": len(row["full_pass"]["attempts"]),
+            "mark_attempt_count": len(row["mark_pass"]["attempts"]),
+            "full_response_sha256": [attempt.get("response_sha256") for attempt in row["full_pass"]["attempts"]],
+            "mark_response_sha256": [attempt.get("response_sha256") for attempt in row["mark_pass"]["attempts"]],
+        })
+    residual = {
+        "schema_version": "9709_unseen_local_two_pass_residual_review_v1",
+        "issue": ISSUE,
+        "row_count": len(residual_rows),
+        "rows": residual_rows,
+    }
+    return summary, candidates, residual
+
+
+def raw_hash_inventory(rows: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    return {
+        "schema_version": "9709_unseen_local_two_pass_raw_hash_inventory_v1",
+        "issue": ISSUE,
+        "candidate_only_not_canonical_truth": True,
+        "rows": [{
+            "question_id": row["question_id"],
+            "source_crop_sha256": row["source_crop_sha256"],
+            "rendered_image_sha256": row["image_inventory"],
+            "full_request_intent_sha256": [
+                sha256_bytes(canonical_bytes(attempt.get("request"))) for attempt in row["full_pass"]["attempts"]
+            ],
+            "full_response_sha256": [attempt.get("response_sha256") for attempt in row["full_pass"]["attempts"]],
+            "mark_request_intent_sha256": [
+                sha256_bytes(canonical_bytes(attempt.get("request"))) for attempt in row["mark_pass"]["attempts"]
+            ],
+            "mark_response_sha256": [attempt.get("response_sha256") for attempt in row["mark_pass"]["attempts"]],
+        } for row in rows],
+    }
+
+
+def run_batch(args: argparse.Namespace) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    if not re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]*", args.run_id):
+        raise RuntimeError("unsafe_run_id_global_stop")
+    manifest, truth = validate_inputs(args.manifest, args.manifest_sha256, args.truth)
+    run_root = args.run_root / args.run_id
+    checkpoint_path = run_root / "checkpoint.jsonl"
+    completed = index_rows(load_checkpoint(checkpoint_path), "question_id", "checkpoint")
